section_summary.extract_value: This study examined the psychometric properties and factor structure of the Persian Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) in Iran with 568 men and 525 women from seven universities in Tehran. The Persian BAS-2 demonstrated a one-factor solution similar to the original English version, with satisfactory convergent validity and internal consistency, and men scored significantly higher on BAS-2 than women.
